desc:
🎲 Two choices. One outfit. How RARE will YOUR final look be?

Welcome to Would You Rather: RNG Contest Tower! 👑✨  
Pick between 2 random avatar items at each stage, climb the tower, and build the luckiest outfit you can!

👗 Choose your hair, clothes, faces & accessories!  
🎲 Every stage gives you RANDOM items with different rarities!  
🍀 Get lucky and find EPIC, MYTHIC, LEGENDARY & even SECRET items!  
🔄 Don't like your choices? Use MIX and roll again!  
✨ Build a beautiful outfit… or end up completely mismatched!  
🏆 Reach the top and compete to see who created the BEST look!  
📸 Show off your final outfit and take pictures!  
👯 Play with friends and compare who gets the rarest outfit!

💎 Will you get lucky enough to create the ULTIMATE outfit?

🎲 Try another run — every climb gives you completely new choices!

🛍️ Earn rewards and explore the shop for awesome items, boosts & effects!

⭐ Enjoyed playing? Like & favorite the game!
